title: VIN decoder and ELF triage names of batch p3-G12-2 (vin_decoder, elf_triage)

attributes.vin_summary: one plain-language line about a VIN (P320): WMI manufacturer/make, ISO 3780 country, model-year candidates, check-digit outcome and, when the opt-in vPIC step ran, the decoded make/model/year (US-market data)
attributes.vin_wmi: World Manufacturer Identifier of a VIN (positions 1-3) from the bundled NHTSA table: {wmi, manufacturer (NHTSA registrant), make, vehicle_types, source nhtsa_vpic|curated, small_manufacturer}; the serial is never included
attributes.vin_country: country of the VIN's WMI assignment from the ISO 3780 range of its first two characters (never vPIC's registrant country)
attributes.vin_check_digit: position-9 check digit of a VIN: {expected, actual, matches, enforced, note}; enforced only for North American WMIs (first character 1-5), elsewhere a mismatch is a note, never 'invalid' (P320 c2)
attributes.vin_validity: offline VIN validity: 'valid' or 'invalid' (only a North American VIN with a failing check digit is invalid)
attributes.vin_model_years: model years encoded at VIN position 10 (30-year cycle; narrowed by position 7 for North American VINs; only a hint elsewhere)
attributes.vin_labelled: VINs found next to a VIN/chassi label in a keyword input (P320 c1): list {vin_masked, label, wmi, country, make, validity}; never a bare 17-character token
attributes.vehicle_make: vehicle make decoded by NHTSA vPIC for a VIN (US-market data)
attributes.vehicle_model: vehicle model decoded by NHTSA vPIC for a VIN (US-market data)
attributes.vehicle_model_year: model year decoded by NHTSA vPIC for a VIN
attributes.vehicle_details: other vPIC decode fields of a VIN: {manufacturer, vehicle_type, body_class, trim, series, doors, drive_type, fuel_primary, gvwr, plant {city, state, country, company}, engine {cylinders, displacement_l, hp, configuration, model}}; never owner, plate or registration data (P320 c4)
attributes.vpic_result: NHTSA vPIC answer metadata for a VIN: {error_codes, errors [{code, text, flag}], reason, scope (US-centric label), vehicle_descriptor}
attributes.elf_summary: one plain-language line about an ELF file (P368): kind, architecture, linkage and interpreter, needed-library/import/export counts, stripped or not, packer hints
attributes.elf_arch: architecture of an ELF file, e.g. 'x86-64 (64-bit LE)', 'MIPS (32-bit BE)'
attributes.elf_kind: ELF file kind: executable, pie executable, shared object, relocatable object or core dump
attributes.elf_interpreter: program interpreter (PT_INTERP) of an ELF file, e.g. /lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2
attributes.elf_linkage: 'dynamic' or 'static' linkage of an ELF file
attributes.elf_needed: shared libraries an ELF file needs (DT_NEEDED, capped)
attributes.elf_dynamic: other dynamic-section facts of an ELF file: {soname, rpath, runpath, pie}
attributes.elf_imports: imported (undefined) dynamic symbols of an ELF file (toolchain/CRT names hidden, capped; the count keeps the total)
attributes.elf_exports: exported (defined global/weak, default/protected visibility) dynamic symbols of an ELF file (capped)
attributes.elf_symbols: symbol facts of an ELF file: {imports_count, exports_count, stripped, symtab_globals (sample of global functions when .symtab is present)}
attributes.elf_sections: sections of an ELF file: list {name, type, size, entropy}
attributes.elf_build_id: GNU build-id (NT_GNU_BUILD_ID) of an ELF file: a sample identifier, also a keyword pivot with expand=False
attributes.elf_compiler: compiler/toolchain strings from the .comment section of an ELF file
attributes.elf_markers: static triage markers of an ELF file (all INFO hints, never verdicts): list {id, detail} with ids upx_packed, packed_unknown, high_entropy_section, high_entropy_segment, no_section_headers, nonstandard_interpreter, truncated, out_of_bounds, parse_error, output_capped

tags.vin_check_digit_mismatch: a North American VIN whose position-9 check digit does not match (typo, altered/cloned VIN or non-compliant record)
tags.elf_hint: static ELF triage hint (packer markers, entropy, missing section headers, unusual interpreter): context, never a verdict

relations.has_build_id: file -> keyword: the GNU build-id recorded in an ELF file (sample identifier; listed, not expanded)
